knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A schedule sets responsibilities, a roster, frequencies and products. The other options leave out required elements or add items the guideline does not require.
The guideline lists frequencies and methods, staffing, equipment and consumables, and management of the service. Option A is the only complete match.
The guideline requires the schedule to be adjusted for the known agent, following the risk assessment. The other options either ignore the risk or stop necessary work.

practicalCriteria: Learner locates the current schedule and reads out the frequency for three items in the assigned area.
Learner completes a task record against the schedule without gaps for one shift.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed task log for one shift
Assessor record of the schedule lines read
stopWorkCriteria: Schedule is missing or unclear for an area being cleaned
Learner is asked to change a product or frequency without a written instruction
